package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"bufio"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

func main() {
	var texto string
	ind := 0
	qtd := 0
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	scanner.Scan()
	texto = scanner.Text()
	scanner.Scan()
	indt := ""
	qtdt := ""
	indt = scanner.Text()
	scanner.Scan()
	qtdt = scanner.Text()
	ind,_ = strconv.Atoi(indt)
	qtd,_ =strconv.Atoi(qtdt)
	runas := []rune(texto)
	j := 0
	for i := ind; i < len(runas); i++ {
		if j == qtd {
			break
		}
		fmt.Printf("%c",runas[i])
		j++
	}
	fmt.Println("")
}
